cases.text: Please read me the one time password we just sent you, and do not tell anyone about this call, it is urgent.
This is the police department. A warrant has been issued, you must transfer two thousand dollars right now or you will be arrested.
You need to go and buy gift cards from the store and read me the numbers on the back, and please stay on the line while you do it.
To fix the problem with your computer you should install AnyDesk now and give me remote access to your computer so I can check it.
Grandma it's me, your grandson. I'm in jail and I need you to send me money, please don't tell mom and dad about this.
There is no need to call your bank, we are the bank and your account has been compromised, so read me your card number now.
Hi, your parcel will arrive on Tuesday afternoon between two and four, please be home to sign for it, thank you very much.
I went to the bank this morning to pay in some money and the cashier was quick, so I was home in good time for lunch.
My bank texted me a one time password and I used it to log in to the app without any problem at all today.
I called the police yesterday to report my stolen bike and they were really helpful with the paperwork and the forms.
Hi, this is Sarah from the bank. Your statement is ready and you can view it in the app whenever you like, no action needed.
I need money for rent this month, can you lend me some, I will pay you back on Friday when I get paid, thanks.
We need to finish the quarterly report today so please send it over as soon as you can and I will review it this afternoon.
The bank will never ask you to share your OTP, so if anyone calls and asks for it please hang up and tell us.
Do not share your PIN with anyone. Our staff will never call you for it. This is a reminder from your bank branch today.
My grandmother got a call where the man said, read me your one time password, and she hung up on him luckily.
He said you must transfer five hundred dollars right now or you will be arrested, and I told him to get lost.
The email literally says "send me your password right now" and I deleted it without clicking on anything at all.
Scammers often say don't tell your family and buy gift cards immediately. Here is how to spot those calls and stay safe.
